Name: Cooking food remake 1.6 update
Author: lv2399664125
Description:
everyone，happy new year（Chinese year of the loong）
先祝大家龙年快乐
Because the buff of most foods are too weak for me to tolerate,so i remake it！
大部分食物太TM弱了加点能量就完事了，逼迫我这个强迫症不得不进行重制
Modified according to raw materials, such as crops to increase planting skills, fruits to increase foraging skills, fish to increase fishing skills, mushrooms to increase mining skills
原理是按照原材料增加的，例如农作物增加种植技能，水果增加觅食技能，鱼类增加钓鱼技能，蘑菇增加挖矿技能
The price is based （all of the raw material ）*2+50
价格＝所有原材料×2＋50
这是我的b站首页有兴趣的可以看看[url=https://space.bilibili.com/10164638?spm_id_from=333.1007.0.0]出门老司机[/url]
